title: Introduction To Agricultural Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the economic cost or real cost of producing a specified quantity of a product."
Opportunity cost is the economic cost or real cost of producing a specified quantity of a product.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a linear function of this form: TVC = Px1X1 + Px2X2."
Mathematically the variable cost is a linear function of this form: TVC = Px1X1 + Px2X2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a physical or technical relationship between inputs and output in any given production processes."
Production function is a physical or technical relationship between inputs and output in any given production processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agrarian nation going by the singular contributions of this sector to the country's socio-economic development."
Nigeria is an agrarian nation going by the singular contributions of this sector to the country's socio-economic development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first derivative of the Total cost function, that is, MC = dTC / dY."
The exact marginal cost is the first derivative of the Total cost function, that is, MC = dTC / dY.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the explicit costs or direct costs of production."
The accounting costs are the explicit costs or direct costs of production.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the means whereby the selfinterest of buyers and sellers acts to serve the needs of society as well as those of individual market participants."
Economic competition is the means whereby the selfinterest of buyers and sellers acts to serve the needs of society as well as those of individual market participants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the long run equilibrium price."
Normal price is the long run equilibrium price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical relationship between the total cost of production and the output produced."
Cost Functions A cost function is a mathematical relationship between the total cost of production and the output produced.
